Verified after a page reload that it persists, and checked the workspace Labels page (/labels), which still lists only Backend, Docs and Frontend — so the existing label was reused, no duplicate created. The only label displayed for the task is "Backend".

On the task detail page http://127.0.0.1:8096/tasks/8 I clicked the comment editor in the Comments section (placeholder "Add your comment, hit '/' for more options…"), typed 'Comment for run fwvk2-n3' (the prosemirror recipe filled and verified the value), and clicked the "Comment" button. The comment posted immediately — the comments region now reads "admin / less than a minute ago / Comment for run fwvk2-n3", and Edit/Delete controls appeared for it. The comment text displayed is exactly "Comment for run fwvk2-n3", which contains 'fwvk2-n3'.
